**NEW BRUNN–MINKOWSKI AND FUNCTIONAL INEQUALITIES VIA CONVEXITY OF ENTROPY**

*GAUTAM AISHWARYA AND LIRAN ROTEM*

32 pp, 12 sections.

**Abstract.** We study the connection between the concavity properties of a measureνand the convexity properties of the associated relative entropyD(·∥ν) along optimal transport. As a corollary we prove a new dimensional Brunn–Minkowski inequality for centered star-shaped bod- ies, when the measureνis log-concave with a p-homogeneous potential (such as the Gaussian measure). Our method allows us to go beyond the usual convexity assumption on the sets that is fundamentally essential for the standard differential-geometric technique in this area. We then take a finer look at the convexity properties of the Gauss- ian relative entropy, which yields new functional inequalities. First we obtain curvature and dimensional reinforcements to Otto–Villani’s HWI inequality in Gauss space, when restricted to even strongly log-concave measures.
